Official TDesign Web Components subset
======================================

The CordisX renderer includes a mechanically bundled subset of
tdesign-web-components 1.2.10 and code reached by those components from:

- TDesign, Omi, reactive-signal, and omi-transition (Tencent contributors)
- weakmap-polyfill (copyright 2015-2021 polygonplanet)
- clsx (copyright Luke Edwards <luke.edwards05@gmail.com>)
- tailwind-merge (copyright 2021 Dany Castillo)
- lodash-es (OpenJS Foundation and other contributors; based on Underscore.js,
  copyright Jeremy Ashkenas, DocumentCloud, and Investigative Reporters & Editors)
- Popper Core (copyright 2019 Federico Zivolo and contributors)

All packages above identify their bundled code as MIT licensed. TDesign's
published notice is:
